persistent_leveling.stage_exp_award: Both user and selected persistent hero receive the same final stage EXP. Hero EXP above its current account-level cap is banked until the account levels up.

element_upgrade.success_rate: Existing success-rate formulas are unchanged; resources are consumed on failure.
